note: 2.0.137: content-record 加入分组 button now reaches clients - the assets view was loading publish.js with a cache buster (20261009) older than the commit (2026-10-11) that added the button, so any client that had that URL cached kept the old script; the buster is now 20261014-content-group-v12. Contacts sync: only rows inside the friends-list rect are used (contacts_list_mismatch aborts instead of clicking another window), rows hidden under the sticky header are refused, small 2-row nudges, zero ESC, row clicks verified against the window under the cursor, refuse to start when the list viewport is under 300px, checkpoint every contact immediately, faster card confirmation (~2-3s per contact) and after a collapse the list scrolls back to the last processed contact and continues from there (contacts_resume_anchor) instead of restarting at the head.
